Module com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku
Package com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.model.validator

Class SudokuValidator

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.model.validator.SudokuValidator
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISudokuValidator
public class SudokuValidator extends Object implements ISudokuValidator
Class responsible for validating Sudoku rules and board states. Provides methods for validating rows, columns, blocks, moves, and determining the current game state.
